ai_summary.text:
澁谷工業はボトリングシステムと充填包装機械の大手メーカーで、飲料・医薬品・化粧品の充填ラインと滅菌装置を主力としている。飲料メーカーのペットボトル充填ラインで国内トップクラスのシェアを持ち、無菌充填技術と高速ボトリングシステムで食品・飲料の安全な大量生産を支えるリーディングカンパニー。レーザー加工事業も展開。

売上1,290億円（前年比+11.8%）と堅調な増収を達成。営業利益137億円（営業利益率10.7%）と二桁の利益率を実現し、純利益101億円。飲料メーカーの設備更新と医薬品の充填装置需要が業績を牽引した。ROE9.3%と良好な資本効率を達成。

自己資本比率67.7%と高い水準にあり、財務健全性スコア93点と極めて健全な財務基盤。営業CF91億円、FCF25億円と安定したキャッシュ創出力。EPS363円に対しPER8.9倍と割安な水準、配当95円で配当性向は約26%。飲料・医薬品の充填設備更新需要が中長期の安定成長を支えている。
ai_summary.text_en: Shibuya Kogyo is a major manufacturer of bottling systems and filling/packaging machinery, with filling lines for beverages, pharmaceuticals, and cosmetics, as well as sterilization equipment, as core products. The company holds top-class domestic market share in beverage bottle filling lines and is a leading company supporting safe mass production of food and beverages through aseptic filling technology and high-speed bottling systems. The company also operates a laser processing business. Sales achieved solid growth of 129.0 billion yen (YoY +11.8%), with operating profit of 13.7 billion yen yielding double-digit operating margin of 10.7%, and net income of 10.1 billion yen. Beverage maker equipment replacements and pharmaceutical filling equipment demand drove performance. ROE reached a favorable 9.3%. The equity ratio of 67.7% is at a high level with financial health score of 93 points, demonstrating extremely sound financial position. Operating cash flow of 9.1 billion yen and free cash flow of 2.5 billion yen ensure stable cash generation. Against EPS of 363 yen, PER stands at 8.9x at an undervalued level, with dividends of 95 yen representing approximately 26% payout ratio. Beverage and pharmaceutical filling equipment replacement demand supports medium to long-term stable growth.
